label: LoRa symbol chirp
about: A repeated, explicitly chosen LoRa symbol with phase-continuous frequency wrapping, based on Chiani and Elzanaty (2019). Direction mirrors the chirp. This model includes no packet, coding, CRC or LoRaWAN interpretation; sweep width is not certified occupied bandwidth.
